rules.text: Every button, input, select, segmented control and stepper on one row uses the same height token. Default 32px (--cf-h-sm).
Only radius tokens: --cf-r-xs 2, --cf-r-control 4, --cf-r-container 8, --cf-r-pill. Nested radius = outer − padding. Literal px radii are not allowed.

exceptions.toast: 0 left, --cf-r-toast (2px) on the right corners only

rules.text: Colours come only from semantic --cf- tokens. No hex, rgb() or hsl() in app or component CSS. Primitives (--cf-gray-*, --cf-blue-*, …) are for tokens only.
No shadow at rest. --cf-elev-* only on menu, popover, modal, toast and hovered/selected canvas cards.
Do not restyle focus. The base layer draws 2px --cf-focus; flush containers set --cf-focus-offset:-2px.

Use the existing component for each job (see components.json). Do not add a class that duplicates one: figures are .cf-kpi, key/values are .cf-prop, in-place edits are .cf-edit, resizing is .cf-resize + cf-resize.js.
Numbers use IBM Plex Sans tabular figures (.cf-num / .is-num): right-aligned in table columns, left in property lists. Mono only for code, formulas, identifiers.
Kinds: primary, is-secondary, is-tertiary, is-ghost; tone is-danger. At most one primary per .cf-btn-set or header. Labels are verbs in sentence case inside <span>.
.cf-btn.is-split hugs its content. Never set a width on it; the chevron area matches a trailing icon (16px icon, 4px tighter padding).
Actions are <button class="cf-btn">. Navigation is <a class="cf-link"> or an <a class="cf-btn"> with href.
Icons come only from @carbon/icons via the sprite: <svg><use href="#icon--name"/></svg> or cfIcon('name'). Every referenced icon must exist in the sprite (run npm run icons).
Icon-only buttons need aria-label. Decorative icons get aria-hidden="true".
State comes from the browser or ARIA (aria-pressed, aria-expanded, aria-busy, disabled), never from a state class. data-cf-state is for specimens only.
Set the theme with data-cf-theme="white|g100" on .cf. Never hard-code a dark mode.
